title: Papers confirmed by the person's own page (unofficial)
detail: They are listed in self_reported.csv and counted with no citation figure, until a record appears in OpenAlex.

title: What the figures are
detail: Source: OpenAlex only. A paper counts for a person when OpenAlex prints the person's name on it together with an NICT affiliation; its citations are OpenAlex's. OpenAlex indexes fewer papers than Google Scholar, so totals are lower than Scholar's. There is no claimed-versus-counted comparison, as no profile totals are used. Google Scholar, Researchmap and ORCID data are kept in the snapshot but not used.
